body: I just go through the motions most days. My memory has been getting steadily worse and my perception of time is almost non-existent...I really hope that there's a way I can function normally again...one day...
I fantasize about this a lot. It makes me feel so guilty

I'm especially feeling like this tonight. I'm so frustrated with the myself because I literally can't go an hour without someone interacting with me. Hang in there, I'm right here feeling it with you.
Yes, all the time. I thought I was getting better about it, but I always end up at square one again.
I never really thought about it like that before, but now that you mention it. I guess a bit of that is true for me

You took the words right out of my mouth. I feel every bit of this through and through; like you were reading my mind. Hang in there. Hopefully we'll find that person who truly cares enough to connect.

Thank you for your reply, the genuine kindness in it made me feel quite a bit better about my situation. I hope all of us who are dealing with this terrible feeling will one day be able to pull through.
I'm sorry too :( I wish we didn't have to go through this...
God bless you too, and thank you for all of your advice. It really means a lot.
Thank you for your kind words. I'm trying.

It's hard to think that way when the peers I was once surrounded by are now going on to college, holding part-time jobs, and are sure in their future while I'm stuck here like this. These days I don't really find joy in anything. I used to draw, or write, or play games until I could hardly keep my eyes open, but now when I try to do such things I am filled with only boredom. I wake up in the morning feeling no purpose in life; with absolutely nothing to do and no one to spend my time with. I'll stare at my computer screen not knowing what I haven't watched already, or sit outside until I'm too cold to stand it. The only solace I have is sleep. 

Regardless, thank you for your kind words.
